capabilities: Drag a heading or block into another note to insert a link
Insert an embed instead of a link by holding Ctrl or Cmd
Add a block ID to the source block when it has none
Link every block of a multi-block selection in one drag (Pro)
Generate readable block IDs from the block's first words (Pro)
extras: Freemium: core features free; Pro ($15 one-time or $5/month via GitHub Sponsors) enables multi-block drags and readable block IDs. Desktop only, needs Obsidian 1.13.4+. Sign-in uses the GitHub device flow and stores the token in Obsidian's secret storage; no telemetry. Settings suggest other NoteMods plugins.
intentEvidence: This plugin adds that drag gesture.
motivation: It answers the forum request "Create references for headers or blocks by drag-and-drop".
problem: Obsidian only makes heading links from Outline drops or block IDs via link suggestions, and cannot drag a paragraph, list item or callout from the editor.

relations.evidence: The Drag Bi-Link plugin also makes block links, with an Alt drag

summary: Drag-and-drop linker that inserts a link or embed to a heading or block dropped into another note and adds a block ID to the source.
